fields.description: Issue features editorials and commentary on Miami Beach gambling and the closure of hotel bookmaking amid a power struggle between rival gambling groups, with discussion of economic impacts on hotels and local families. Also covers Miami municipal politics and patronage following elections, including changes in city publicity positions; debate over the proposed public library site (Bayfront Park versus Lummus Park) and related civic planning; and national topics including wage/income statistics and criticism of the American Medical Association’s opposition to a national health program. Includes regular columns, local notes, advertisements, and entertainment listings.
